PAY: targets EUR 30,000-40,000 salary or EUR 200/day contract. Do not reject for paying more; note stated ranges.

YOUR LANE: internal AI adoption roles at employers who are NOT primarily software companies - logistics, retail, e-commerce, manufacturing, insurance, banking, healthcare, energy, media, professional services and consultancies, across the EU.
